output.summary: Rust is a modern systems programming language that prioritizes safety and performance through innovative ownership semantics, eliminating common memory-related bugs while maintaining runtime efficiency. Its focus on zero-cost abstractions and fearless concurrency makes it a compelling choice for building reliable, high-performance software.
